title: JR's Roleplay
description: Some nice little improvements for Vanilla+ servers!
body: # Roleplay [WIP] ![Craft gifts using 4 paper, 4 sticks and a special item!](https://lisyak.net/static/gifts-plugin.png) ![Leash other similar to mobs!](https://lisyak.net/static/leashing.png) ## Features - Player leashing (similar to mobs) Right-click another player while holding a leash to capture them. They won’t escape easily—but if they do, the leash will drop! - Player interactions (pat with Shift + RMB) Shift + right-click another player to show particles (hearts by default). - Present crafting (including pranks!) Wrap any item as a gift and give it to another player! Just be careful not to include too many explosives... > Player leashing disables player collision. This feature can be disabled in the config. > Leashes and gift crafting may cause item duplication due to limited testing. If you find any bugs, please open [an issue](https://github.com/lisyakteam/Roleplay/issues). ## Planned - More fun features! Feel free to submit your ideas!
